compiled_state.title: UPDATE tests: deep-tier delta files must include negative scope constraints
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description: ## Testing Mode UPDATE ## Story DD Coverage - DD3: Each reviewer agent definition includes a mandatory pre-output checklist requiring consideration of all 5 categories before writing findings - DD4: deep-tier specialist delta files include explicit negative constraints ('Emit findings only in your owned category') ## What to modify tests/docs/test-reviewer-blindspot-annotations.sh — add tests that: ### test_deep_tier_has_negative_scope_constraint For each deep-tier delta file (reviewer-delta-deep-correctness.md, reviewer-delta-deep-verification.md, reviewer-delta-deep-hygiene.md), build the agent and verify the generated output contains negative scope constraint language: - Language like: 'Emit findings only in your owned category' OR 'Do not emit findings in other dimensions' OR similar explicit 'do NOT' instruction about staying in-scope category Given: reviewer-delta-deep-{correctness,verification,hygiene}.md + reviewer-base.md When: build-review-agents.sh generates the agent file Then: the generated agent contains explicit negative scope constraint text RED: fails until T4 updates the delta files ### test_preoutput_checklist_in_generated_agent For at least one generated agent (e.g., code-reviewer-light), verify the generated agent contains a pre-output category checklist instruction: - Language like: 'Before writing' and mentions of all 5 categories (correctness, verification, hygiene, design, maintainability) OR: 'pre-output checklist' or 'verify all 5 categories' or 'category coverage check' RED: fails until T3 updates reviewer-base.md ### .test-index RED markers - tests/docs/test-reviewer-blindspot-annotations.sh [test_deep_tier_has_negative_scope_constraint] - tests/docs/test-reviewer-blindspot-annotations.sh [test_preoutput_checklist_in_generated_agent] Note: existing test_blindspot_in_deep_arch, test_blindspot_in_standard, etc. MUST remain passing (5 currently pass). ## Acceptance Criteria - [ ] test_deep_tier_has_negative_scope_constraint exists   Verify: grep -q 'test_deep_tier_has_negative_scope_constraint' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/docs/test-reviewer-blindspot-annotations.sh - [ ] .test-index has RED markers for both new tests   Verify: grep -q 'test_deep_tier_has_negative_scope_constraint' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index - [ ] Existing 5 tests still pass (not all 7): bash tests/docs/test-reviewer-blindspot-annotations.sh | grep 'PASSED: 5'   Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/docs/test-reviewer-blindspot-annotations.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'PASSED: 5' ## Retry Budget MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model) On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
